content: AWS FIS action reference lists native EKS actions: aws:eks:pod-delete, pod-cpu-stress, pod-memory-stress, pod-io-stress, pod-network-latency, pod-network-packet-loss, pod-network-blackhole-port, terminate-nodegroup-instances, inject-kubernetes-custom-resource. Critically aws:ec2:send-spot-instance-interruptions sends a real 2-minute Spot interruption notice (durationBeforeInterruption 2-15 min) - this is the only way to test Spot handling authentically. Chaos Mesh (CNCF incubating) covers pod/network/DNS/HTTP/IO/time/stress/kernel/JVM faults as CRDs with Schedule/Workflow/StatusCheck orchestration and a dashboard; it is free and in-cluster. FIS is pay-per-action-minute but reaches the AWS control plane (Spot, nodegroup, AZ shift) that Chaos Mesh cannot. Complementary, not competing.
